Rungs tried: (1) receiving a purchase order through the front end's own call (POST /api/inventory/orders/accept) for a vendor on COD - the bill still gets a due date (= its invoice date; bill ZZT-P26-BILL, due Nov 06 2026); (2) a vendor with no payment terms cannot be saved - add-vendor answers 400 "credit_term: Missing required parameter"; (3) the code (CreateTransactionWhenDeliveryIsCreated at 8e35ee0d02) only blanks the due date when CreditTerms::getDueDate returns the very same object, which it never does (it always builds a new one), so no new bill can lack a due date. What needs to be done: a developer stores one unpaid bill with an empty due date on QA, then run this case.
